wells_fargo_1930s_dual_origin_plaque.description: Lobby wall plaque: 'Houston Tunnel System — Established 1930s. First tunnel: Ross Sterling under Fannin (1931) and Will Horwitz under Capitol (1935). Inspired by the Rockefeller Center underground concourse.'

esperson_sandra_lord_plaque.description: Wall plaque in the Esperson food court: 'Sandra Lord has led walking tours of the Houston tunnel system since 1991.'

jpmorgan_chase_basement_1950s_corridor.description: Tier 2 signature: 1950s minimal corridor segment, bare concrete walls, older fluorescent, no drop ceiling
